description: Bigeye connector (read-only). Indexes Bigeye data-quality issues as `data_quality_test` items in the local index and exposes three read-only tools to the Nimbus agent (`bigeye_list`, `bigeye_get`, `bigeye_search`). Uses a Bearer API key against a per-tenant Bigeye instance. The per-tenant host is derived from bigeye.base_url at spawn time (like Looker/Tableau). No write tools.
author: Nimbus
